title: A Mist Connection
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
Category: Earth Sciences, Geography, Environment, Planning
summary: In 1783, an eruption occurred in Iceland. Soon after, a dry fog descended upon mainland Europe. These two events long went unconnected. "A Mist Connection" documents the Laki eruption and its consequences for Iceland and the wider world. The book combines methods of historical disaster research, climate history, global history, history of science, and geology in an interdisciplinary approach.
